Implementation approach: We will build a comprehensive Laravel 10+ API system for OOP (Out-of-Pocket) Expenses with three interconnected modules. The implementation follows Laravel best practices with a mental model of: Client -> versioned routes with auth middleware -> thin controllers -> Form Request validation with policies -> domain services -> API Resources for response shaping. We'll use Eloquent ORM with explicit relationships, Laravel's built-in validation and policy systems, queue jobs for background processing, and API Resources to hide internal fields. The architecture emphasizes multi-tenancy (all operations scoped by client_id), role-based delegation through user_feature_permission table, atomic validation for CSV uploads, real-time FX conversion with user override capability, and comprehensive soft delete patterns. We'll leverage existing Volopa infrastructure including OAuth2 middleware, FX services, file storage, and queue system while maintaining backwards compatibility.

Program call flow:
sequenceDiagram
    participant C as Client
    participant MW as Oauth2UserClient
    participant UFPC as UserFeaturePermissionController
    participant UFPS as UserFeaturePermissionService
    participant UFPM as UserFeaturePermission
    participant PEC as PocketExpenseController
    participant PES as PocketExpenseService
    participant FXS as FXConversionService
    participant PE as PocketExpense
    participant PEUC as PocketExpenseUploadController
    participant PECSVV as PocketExpenseCSVValidator
    participant PEFU as PocketExpenseFileUpload
    participant PEUD as PocketExpenseUploadsData
    participant Q as Queue
    participant PEU as ProcessExpenseUpload
    
    Note over C,PEU: User Permission Management Flow
    C->>MW: POST /api/v1/user-feature-permissions
    MW->>UFPC: allow (authenticated)
    UFPC->>UFPS: grantPermission(data)
    UFPS->>UFPM: create(permission_data)
    UFPM-->>UFPS: permission_instance
    UFPS-->>UFPC: UserFeaturePermission
    UFPC-->>C: 201 UserFeaturePermissionResource
    
    Note over C,PEU: Single Expense CRUD with FX Conversion Flow
    C->>MW: POST /api/v1/pocket-expenses
    MW->>PEC: allow (authenticated)
    PEC->>FXS: getWalletBaseCurrency(client_id)
    FXS-->>PEC: base_currency_data
    PEC->>FXS: getFXRate(from_currency, to_currency, date)
    FXS-->>PEC: fx_rate
    PEC->>FXS: convertAmount(amount, fx_rate, commission)
    FXS-->>PEC: converted_amount
    PEC->>PES: createExpense(validated_data)
    PES->>PE: create(expense_data)
    PE-->>PES: expense_instance
    PES-->>PEC: PocketExpense
    PEC-->>C: 201 PocketExpenseResource
    
    Note over C,PEU: CSV Batch Upload Flow
    C->>MW: POST /api/uploads/pocket-expense/csv
    MW->>PEUC: allow (authenticated)
    PEUC->>PEUC: validateFile(file)
    PEUC->>PEFU: create(upload_record)
    PEFU-->>PEUC: upload_instance
    PEUC->>PECSVV: validate(csv_path, user_id, client_id)
    PECSVV->>PECSVV: preloadReferenceData()
    PECSVV->>PECSVV: validateHeaders(headers)
    loop Each CSV Row
        PECSVV->>PECSVV: validateRow(row_data, line_number)
    end
    PECSVV-->>PEUC: validation_result
    alt Validation Failed
        PEUC->>PEFU: update(status=validation_failed, errors)
        PEUC-->>C: 422 Error Response
    else Validation Passed
        PEUC->>PEUD: bulkInsert(validated_rows)
        PEUD-->>PEUC: success
        PEUC->>PEFU: update(status=processing)
        PEUC->>Q: dispatch(ProcessExpenseUpload)
        PEUC-->>C: 200 Success Response
        Q->>PEU: handle()
        loop Batch Processing
            PEU->>PES: createExpense(expense_data)
            PES->>PE: create(expense_data)
        end
        PEU->>PEFU: update(status=completed)
    end
System constraints: Maximum 200 rows per CSV file upload
All-or-nothing validation: if any CSV row fails validation, no expenses are created
FX rate lookup maximum 30-day lookback from expense date
Merchant Name maximum length VARCHAR(180) per database definition
Only Primary Administrator has full access to all users by default
All queries and mutations must be scoped by client_id for multi-tenancy
user_id must match authenticated user with server-side verification
Target entities (expense_user_id) must belong to the same client_id
Routes must be added to routes/api.php under authentication middleware
Controllers must be thin and delegate business logic to services
Use transactions when touching multiple database tables
Return proper HTTP status codes (200, 201, 204, 400, 401, 403, 404, 422)
Create API Resources to shape responses and hide internal fields
Use Form Request classes for validation with policy enforcement
Date format for CSV must be DD/MM/YYYY, not older than 3 years
Currency Code must be 3-letter ISO and in platform allowed list
Amount sign determined by expense type (Refund = positive, others = negative)
VAT percentage must be numeric between 0-100, strip % sign
Source must match configured sources for client including global Other
Source Note required when Source = Other
Maximum 20 active expense sources per client
Unique source names per client (client_id, name constraint)
InnoDB engine required for all new tables
Character set utf8mb4 with utf8mb4_unicode_ci collation
Soft delete using deleted TINYINT(1) and delete_time DATETIME pattern
Timestamp pattern using create_time/update_time DATETIME columns
Do not return raw Eloquent models from API endpoints
Do not use session/redirect patterns in APIs
Do not return 200 status codes for error conditions
Do not expose stack traces or sensitive error details
Do not disable mass-assignment protection
Do not build query filters directly from user input
Do not create N+1 queries, especially in API Resources
Do not return unbounded lists without pagination
Do not forget transactions for multi-write operations
Backend must recalculate FX rates on save, do not trust frontend values
Commission formula: AdjustedRate = BaseRate × (1 - Commission%)
CSV file maximum size 10MB (10240 KB)
CSV header row mandatory with exact column name matching
File format must be CSV or TXT with CSV content
Notes field must be trimmed and prevent SQL injection
Global 'Other' expense source (client_id = NULL) not deletable or editable
Three default sources auto-created on feature enable: Cash, Corporate Card, Personal Card
Expense status enum values: draft, submitted, approved, rejected
Expense type amount_sign enum values: positive, negative
Permission is_enabled boolean defaults to true
All new migrations must follow Laravel naming conventions
Models must define explicit relationships with proper foreign key constraints
